units.source_text: 男人觉察到了女人的顺从，总算恢复了自制。

en.t: The man sensed the woman's submission and finally regained his self-control.

units.source_text: 他把已塞进一半的手巾掏了出来又重新塞进去，然后，在女人的后脑勺处打了个结。

en.t: He pulled out the towel he had already pushed halfway in, stuffed it back in again, and then tied a knot at the back of the woman's head.

units.source_text: 接着，他用事先准备好的绑腿布，把女人的两手用力反绑到背后。

en.t: Next, using the strips of gaiter cloth he had prepared beforehand, he forcefully bound the woman's hands behind her back.
